setup: CREATE TABLE t(s VARCHAR); INSERT INTO t VALUES ('hello world'), ('abc123def'), (''), (NULL), ('héllo')  -- multi-statement pins: query lines map 1:1 to ' | '-separated observed segments

pins.claim: Default (no group arg) returns the WHOLE match (group 0 semantics), even when capture groups exist
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('hello world', 'l+')
SELECT regexp_extract('hello world', '(\w+) (\w+)')

pins.claim: Explicit group 0 = whole match and is identical to the 2-arg form
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('hello world', '(\w+) (\w+)', 0)
SELECT regexp_extract('abc123','[0-9]+') = regexp_extract('abc123','[0-9]+',0)

pins.claim: Explicit groups 1 and 2 return the capture texts
pins.query: SELECT regexp_extract('hello world', '(\w+) (\w+)', 1), regexp_extract('hello world', '(\w+) (\w+)', 2)

pins.claim: Group index beyond the pattern's group count but <= 9 is NOT an error — returns '' (group 3 of 2-group pattern; group 1 of 0-group pattern; group 9 of 2-group pattern)
pins.query: SELECT regexp_extract('hello world', '(\w+) (\w+)', 3), regexp_extract('hello world', 'l+', 1), regexp_extract('ab', '(a)(b)', 9)

pins.claim: Group index is hard-capped at 0..9: group 10 errors EVEN with a 10-group pattern; group 9 of that pattern works
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('abcdefghij', '(a)(b)(c)(d)(e)(f)(g)(h)(i)(j)', 10)
SELECT regexp_extract('abcdefghij', '(a)(b)(c)(d)(e)(f)(g)(h)(i)(j)', 9)
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Group index must be between 0 and 9! | [('i',)]

pins.claim: Negative group index -> same range error; the error fires regardless of whether the subject would match
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('abc', '(a)', -1)
SELECT regexp_extract('zzz', '(a)', 100)
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Group index must be between 0 and 9! | ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Group index must be between 0 and 9!

pins.claim: NO MATCH returns empty string '', NOT NULL — with or without an explicit group
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('abc', 'x'), regexp_extract('abc', 'x') IS NULL, regexp_extract('abc', 'x') = ''
SELECT regexp_extract('abc', '(x)', 1), regexp_extract('abc', '(x)', 1) IS NULL

pins.claim: Matching is an unanchored SEARCH (pattern found anywhere), not a full-string match
pins.query: SELECT regexp_extract('abc123def', '[0-9]+'), regexp_extract('hello world', 'lo wo')

pins.claim: Explicit anchors are honored within the search: ^world fails, ^hello and world$ succeed
pins.query: SELECT regexp_extract('hello world', '^world'), regexp_extract('hello world', '^hello'), regexp_extract('hello world', 'world$')

pins.claim: Only the FIRST (leftmost) match is returned; alternation is leftmost-FIRST not longest ('a|aa' on 'aaa' -> 'a')
pins.query: SELECT regexp_extract('a1b22c333', '[0-9]+'), regexp_extract('aaa', 'a|aa')

pins.claim: NULL subject -> NULL; NULL pattern -> NULL
pins.query: SELECT regexp_extract(NULL, 'a'), regexp_extract(NULL, 'a') IS NULL, regexp_extract('a', NULL), regexp_extract('a', NULL) IS NULL

pins.claim: SURPRISE: NULL group index does NOT return NULL — it returns '' (both literal NULL and CAST(NULL AS INTEGER))
pins.query: SELECT regexp_extract('abc', '(a)', NULL), regexp_extract('abc', '(a)', NULL) IS NULL, regexp_extract('abc', '(a)', CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)) = ''

pins.claim: Empty pattern / empty subject / zero-length matches all return '' (never NULL): empty pattern on 'abc' and ''; group 1 of empty pattern; 'a' and '.*' on ''; 'x*','b*' on 'abc'
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('abc', ''), regexp_extract('abc', '') IS NULL, regexp_extract('', ''), regexp_extract('abc', '', 1)
SELECT regexp_extract('', 'a'), regexp_extract('', 'a') = '', regexp_extract('', '.*'), regexp_extract('', '.*') = ''
SELECT regexp_extract('abc', 'x*'), regexp_extract('abc', 'b*')

pins.claim: Result type is VARCHAR for both the 2-arg and 3-arg integer forms
pins.query: SELECT typeof(regexp_extract('abc', 'b')), typeof(regexp_extract('abc', '(b)', 1))

pins.claim: Nested groups number left-to-right by open paren: '(a(b)c)' on 'abc' -> g0='abc', g1='abc', g2='b', g3=''
pins.query: SELECT regexp_extract('abc', '(a(b)c)', 0), regexp_extract('abc', '(a(b)c)', 1), regexp_extract('abc', '(a(b)c)', 2), regexp_extract('abc', '(a(b)c)', 3)

pins.claim: Non-participating groups return '' NOT NULL: alternation '(a)|(b)' on 'b' g1='' (IS NULL False) g2='b'; optional 'a(b)?c' on 'ac' g1=''
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('b', '(a)|(b)', 1), regexp_extract('b', '(a)|(b)', 1) IS NULL, regexp_extract('b', '(a)|(b)', 2)
SELECT regexp_extract('ac', 'a(b)?c', 1), regexp_extract('ac', 'a(b)?c', 1) = ''

pins.claim: Name-list 3rd arg returns a STRUCT (non-scalar; out of scalar-engine scope): one field per name, values = groups 1..N positionally, field order = list order
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('2023-04-15', '(\d+)-(\d+)-(\d+)', ['y','m','d'])
SELECT typeof(regexp_extract('2023-04-15', '(\d+)-(\d+)-(\d+)', ['y','m','d']))
SELECT regexp_extract('2023-04', '(\d+)-(\d+)', ['second_named_first','other'])

pins.claim: Name-list form: NO MATCH -> struct of all '' fields; NULL subject -> NULL (whole struct)
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('abc', '(\d+)-(\d+)', ['a','b'])
SELECT regexp_extract(NULL, '(\d+)', ['a']), regexp_extract(NULL, '(\d+)', ['a']) IS NULL

pins.claim: Name-list may name FEWER groups than the pattern has — takes the first N
pins.query: SELECT regexp_extract('2023-04', '(\d+)-(\d+)', ['a'])

pins.claim: Name-list bind errors (verbatim): more names than groups; empty list; duplicate name; NULL name
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('2023-04', '(\d+)-(\d+)', ['a','b','c'])
SELECT regexp_extract('abc', '(a)', [])
SELECT regexp_extract('ab', '(a)(b)', ['x','x'])
SELECT regexp_extract('ab', '(a)(b)', ['x', NULL])
pins.observed: ERROR BinderException: Binder Error: Not enough capturing groups (2) for provided names (3) | ERROR BinderException: Binder Error: Group name list must be non-empty | ERROR BinderException: Binder Error: Duplicate group name 'x' in regexp_extract | ERROR BinderException: Binder Error: NULL group name in regexp_extract

pins.claim: Empty-string name is ALLOWED and yields an unnamed struct field: typeof STRUCT(VARCHAR, VARCHAR)
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('ab', '(a)(b)', ['', 'y'])
SELECT typeof(regexp_extract('ab', '(a)(b)', ['', 'y']))

pins.claim: Name-list requires a CONSTANT pattern (NULL pattern is a bind error here — unlike scalar form) and a CONSTANT list (column list is a runtime error)
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('ab', NULL, ['x'])
SELECT regexp_extract('ab', '(a)(b)', l) FROM (VALUES (['x','y'])) tl(l)
pins.observed: ERROR BinderException: Binder Error: regexp_extract with LIST of group names requires a constant pattern | ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Group specification field must be a constant!

pins.claim: 4th options arg: 'i' = case-insensitive; extracted text preserves ORIGINAL case; works for int-group and name-list forms
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('ABC123', '([a-z]+)', 1, 'i'), regexp_extract('ABC', 'abc', 0, 'i')
SELECT regexp_extract('ABC-12', '([a-z]+)-(\d+)', ['w','n'], 'i')

pins.claim: No (VARCHAR,VARCHAR,VARCHAR) overload — options as 3rd arg is an ambiguity bind error; BIGINT group index is not implicitly cast (error lists the full 5-overload set)
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('ABC', 'abc', 'i')
SELECT regexp_extract('abc123', '([a-z]+)([0-9]+)', CAST(2 AS BIGINT))
pins.observed:

pins.claim: Options errors (verbatim): unrecognized 'q'; 'g' only valid for regexp_replace; NULL options is an ERROR not NULL; options must be a constant
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('a', 'a', 0, 'q')
SELECT regexp_extract('aaa', 'a', 0, 'g')
SELECT regexp_extract('ABC', 'abc', 0, NULL)
SELECT regexp_extract('ABC', 'abc', 0, o) FROM (VALUES ('i')) to_(o)
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Unrecognized Regex option q | ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Option 'g' (global replace) is only valid for regexp_replace | ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Regex options field must not be NULL | ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Regex options field must be a constant

pins.claim: Option 'c' = case-sensitive (the default); empty options string = default; with conflicting flags the LAST wins ('ci' matches, 'ic' does not); 'l' = literal matching
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('ABC', 'abc', 0, 'c'), regexp_extract('ABC', 'abc', 0, ''), regexp_extract('ABC', 'abc', 0, 'ci'), regexp_extract('ABC', 'abc', 0, 'ic')
SELECT regexp_extract('a.c', 'a.c', 0, 'l'), regexp_extract('axc', 'a.c', 0, 'l')

pins.claim: Dot does NOT match newline by default; option 's' makes it match; 'n' keeps it non-matching
pins.query: SELECT regexp_extract('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a.b'), regexp_extract('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a.b', 0, 's'), regexp_extract('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a.b', 0, 'n')

pins.claim: SURPRISE: options 'm'/'n'/'p' do NOT enable multiline ^/$ anchors ('' for all); inline (?m) DOES; inline (?s) and (?i) also work
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '^b', 0, 'm'), regexp_extract('a' || chr(10) || 'b', 'a$', 0, 'm'), regexp_extract('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '^b', 0, 'p'), regexp_extract('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '^b', 0, 'n')
SELECT regexp_extract('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '(?m)^b'), regexp_extract('a' || chr(10) || 'b', '(?s)a.b'), regexp_extract('ABC', '(?i)abc')

pins.claim: UTF-8 aware: '.' matches one CODEPOINT — 'é', a full emoji, one Arabic-Indic digit; non-ASCII capture works
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('héllo', 'h.llo'), regexp_extract('héllo', 'h(é)llo', 1)
SELECT regexp_extract('a😀b', 'a(.)b', 1), regexp_extract('a😀b', '.'), regexp_extract('٣٤', '.')

pins.claim: ASCII-only classes (RE2): [0-9] and \d do NOT match Arabic-Indic '٣٤' (-> ''); \w does not match 'é' so (\w+) on 'héllo' captures only 'h'
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('٣٤', '[0-9]+'), regexp_extract('٣٤', '\d+'), regexp_extract('٣٤', '[0-9]+') = ''
SELECT regexp_extract('héllo', '(\w+)', 1)

pins.claim: Case-insensitive 'i' uses simple folding: 'i' does NOT match 'İ' (U+0130) in 'İstanbul'; '.' still matches 'İ' as one codepoint
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('İstanbul', 'i', 0, 'i'), regexp_extract('İstanbul', 'i', 0, 'i') = ''
SELECT regexp_extract('İstanbul', '^.')

pins.claim: Invalid regex patterns: verbatim RE2 errors for '(' and '['
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('a', '(')
SELECT regexp_extract('a', '[')
pins.observed: ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: missing ): ( | ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: missing ]: [

pins.claim: Per-row over t('hello world','abc123def','',NULL,'héllo'): NULL row -> NULL, others follow scalar rules (note 'héllo' -> 'h' via ASCII \w)
pins.query:
SELECT s, regexp_extract(s, '(\w+)', 1) FROM t
SELECT s, regexp_extract(s, 'l+') FROM t

pins.claim: Pattern MAY be a non-constant column (per-row compile; NULL pattern row -> NULL); group index must be a constant (verbatim runtime error), though constant-foldable exprs like 1+1 are fine
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('abc123', p) FROM (VALUES ('[0-9]+'), ('x'), (NULL)) tp(p)
SELECT regexp_extract('abc123def', '([a-z]+)([0-9]+)', g) FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) tg(g)
SELECT regexp_extract('abc123', '([a-z]+)([0-9]+)', 1+1)
pins.observed: [('123',), ('',), (None,)] | ERROR InvalidInputException: Invalid Input Error: Group specification field must be a constant! | [('123',)]

pins.claim: RE2 named groups (?P<name>...) allowed; integer indexing ignores the name; name-list maps positionally
pins.query:
SELECT regexp_extract('abc123', '(?P<letters>[a-z]+)', 1)
SELECT regexp_extract('abc123', '(?P<letters>[a-z]+)([0-9]+)', ['l','n'])

surprises: NULL group index returns '' (empty string), NOT NULL — unlike NULL subject/pattern which return NULL.
NULL options string is an InvalidInputException ('Regex options field must not be NULL'), not a NULL result.

Group index is hard-capped at 0..9 ('Group index must be between 0 and 9!'): group 10 errors even when the pattern HAS 10 capturing groups, and the error fires even when the subject wouldn't match; but any index in 0..9 beyond the actual group count silently returns ''.
No-match, non-participating groups, and over-count in-range groups all return '' (never NULL) — '' from regexp_extract is ambiguous between no-match and empty capture.
Options 'm'/'n'/'p' (newline-sensitive) do NOT enable multiline ^/$ anchors in 1.5.5; inline (?m) does. Option 's' does enable dot-matches-newline.
In the options string the LAST of conflicting flags wins: 'ci' is case-insensitive, 'ic' is case-sensitive.
Alternation is leftmost-FIRST, not leftmost-longest: 'a|aa' on 'aaa' extracts 'a'.
\d, \w, [0-9] are ASCII-only (RE2): no match on Arabic-Indic '٣٤'; (\w+) on 'héllo' captures just 'h'. But '.' is codepoint-aware (matches a full emoji as one char).

Name-list form: fewer names than groups is allowed (takes first N); more names, empty list, duplicate names, NULL names are bind errors; empty-string name yields an unnamed STRUCT field (typeof STRUCT(VARCHAR, VARCHAR)); NULL pattern is a bind error here (vs NULL result in scalar form).
Pattern may be a per-row column, but group index and options must be constants (runtime InvalidInputException otherwise); BIGINT group index is NOT implicitly cast to INTEGER (binder error).
DuckDB 1.5.5 does not support U&'...' literals ('Parser Error: unicode_to_utf8 NOT IMPLEMENTED') — use direct UTF-8 literals.
recommendation: Engine scope: implement the scalar forms (2-arg, 3-arg INTEGER group, 4-arg options) returning VARCHAR; classify the name-list STRUCT forms (VARCHAR[] 3rd arg, +options) as clean out-of-scope non-scalar. Semantics: unanchored leftmost-first RE2 search; '' for no-match, non-participating groups, and any in-range (0..9) group index above the pattern's group count; NULL only for NULL subject or NULL pattern; NULL group index -> '' and NULL options -> error; constant group index required, range-checked 0..9 with verbatim 'Group index must be between 0 and 9!'; constant options required; options c/i/l/m/n/p/s with last-flag-wins conflicts, 'g' rejected — and m/n/p must NOT enable multiline anchors while inline (?m) does. Match RE2 exactly: ASCII-only \d/\w classes, codepoint-aware '.', simple case folding (no İ->i).
